parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return per page. If set to zero, the API will attempt to return the maximum number of records allowed by its limits.

parameters.description: Field and direction to sort results. Format: field(ascending) or field(descending). Example: name(ascending).

parameters.name: fields

post.description:
Deploy multiple policies (firewall or NAT) in a single batch operation. Each policy will be deployed to all devices currently assigned to it and undeployed from any devices that are no longer assigned.

Devices must be assigned or unassigned using the Assignments API before invoking this operation. Note that to unassign a device from which the policy is already deployed, the force_unassign option in the Assignments API must be used. Subsequent deploy operations for that policy will then undeploy the policy from those devices.

For each device undeploy is processed first, then deploy. For each device, operations are atomic; across devices, some may succeed while others fail. Currently one request can only contain one policy type (all firewall or all nat), but this may be relaxed in the future.

This is an asynchronous operation that returns a deploy ID for tracking the status of the deploy operation.

typeUrl.description:
A URL/resource name that uniquely identifies the type of the serialized
protocol buffer message. This string must contain at least
one "/" character. The last segment of the URL's path must represent
the fully qualified name of the type (as in
`path/google.protobuf.Duration`). The name should be in a canonical form
(e.g., leading "." is not accepted).

In practice, teams usually precompile into the binary all types that they
expect it to use in the context of Any. However, for URLs which use the
scheme `http`, `https`, or no scheme, one can optionally set up a type
server that maps type URLs to message definitions as follows:

* If no scheme is provided, `https` is assumed.
* An HTTP GET on the URL must yield a [google.protobuf.Type][]
  value in binary format, or produce an error.
* Applications are allowed to cache lookup results based on the
  URL, or have them precompiled into a binary to avoid any
  lookup. Therefore, binary compatibility needs to be preserved
  on changes to types. (Use versioned type names to manage
  breaking changes.)

Note: this functionality is not currently available in the official
protobuf release, and it is not used for type URLs beginning with
type.googleapis.com.

Schemes other than `http`, `https` (or the empty scheme) might be
used with implementation specific semantics.

sd_onboarding_completed.description: Indicates whether Security Director specific onboarding steps have completed for the device. "true" means SD onboarding finished successfully; "false" means it has not. An empty value means onboarding has not yet run or its outcome is not yet known. This is a read-only, server-computed field.

certificate_ready.description: Indicates whether the Security Director certificate-deployment job succeeded for the device. "true" means the SD certificates were deployed successfully; "false" means the deployment failed. An empty value means certificate deployment has not yet run or its outcome is not yet known. This is a read-only, server-computed field.

firewall_ready.description: Indicates whether the device is ready for firewall-policy processing. "true" means the device is ready (firewall-policy import/publish completed or nothing is pending); "false" means the most recent firewall-policy import/publish failed. An empty value means a firewall-policy import/publish is still pending. This is a read-only, server-computed field.

nat_ready.description: Indicates whether the device is ready for NAT-policy processing. "true" means the device is ready (NAT-policy import/publish completed or nothing is pending); "false" means the most recent NAT-policy import/publish failed. An empty value means a NAT-policy import/publish is still pending. This is a read-only, server-computed field.

security_log_ready.description: Indicates whether security logging is configured and ready on the device. "true" means the configure-security-logs job completed successfully; "false" means security logging was skipped or its configuration failed. An empty value means security-log configuration has not yet run or its outcome is not yet known. This is a read-only, server-computed field.

ValidateTemplateRequest represents a request to validate template configuration.
This message contains template parameters for validation against template schema and syntax.

enable_proxy.description: When true, enables proxy server (proxy_default) for device connectivity. When false, clears any existing proxy server configuration from the device.

uuids.description: Array of device UUIDs to reboot. Supports both single and multiple devices reboot operation.
Array of device UUIDs to sync. Supports both single and multiple device sync operation.

status.description: Status of the upload operation (SUCCESS, FAILURE, PARTIAL_SUCCESS)

message.description: Message describing the overall upload result

total_records.description: Total number of records processed from the CSV file

error_message.description: Error message if the upload operation failed (empty on success)

params.description: Array of device-specific parameter mappings. Each DeviceParam contains device type (DEVICE/DEVICE_GROUP), device ID, and payload with template variable values.

global_params.description: Global parameters that apply to all devices in the deployment.

standalone.description: Routing instance name for standalone device

ipaddr.description: IP address of the packet-log destination host.

port.description: Port of the packet-log destination host.

source_address.description: Source IP address used when sending packet logs.

id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the target device, device group, or cluster

payload.description: JSON object containing template variable values specific to this target. These values override global_params for this device. Sample payload for banner template: {"message":"banner-message"}

params.description: Array of device-specific parameter mappings. Each DeviceParam contains device type (DEVICE/DEVICE_GROUP), device ID, and payload with template variable values.

global_params.description: Global parameters that apply to all devices in the deployment.

node0.description: Routing instance name for cluster node 0

node1.description: Routing instance name for cluster node 1

params.description: Array of device-specific parameter mappings. Each DeviceParam contains device type (DEVICE/DEVICE_GROUP), device ID, and payload with template variable values.

global_params.description: Global parameters that apply to all devices in the deployment.

ActivationConfig.title: ActivationConfig

config_format.description: Format of the configuration content. Typically 'text' for CLI commands or 'xml' for XML configuration. Determines how the device should interpret the config_contents field.

config_contents.description: The actual configuration content to be applied to the device. Format depends on config_format field. For 'text' format, this contains CLI set commands. For 'xml' format, this contains hierarchical XML configuration.

ActivationConfig.description: Bootstrap configuration for device reactivation or reactivation, including format type and configuration content.

ipv6.description: Enable IPv6 for the devices. Defaults to false. Supported only in Juniper Security Director Cloud.

devices.description: Devices to onboard. Each entry can be ZTP or BROWN_FIELD with its respective parameters.

BulkCreateDeviceResponse.title: BulkCreateDeviceResponse

devices.description: List of devices with UUIDs and per-device onboarding status

BulkCreateDeviceResponse.description: Batch device onboarding response with per-device status

BulkDeviceInfo.title: BulkDeviceInfo

serial_number.description: Serial number of the device. Required when onboarding_type is ZTP.

root_pwd.description: Root password for device authentication. Required when onboarding_type is ZTP.

device_count.description: Number of device entries to create. Required when onboarding_type is BROWN_FIELD.

BulkDeviceInfo.description: Single device onboarding entry. ZTP devices require serial_number and root_pwd and only supported in Security Director Cloud. BROWN_FIELD devices require type and device_count.

uuid.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the device. Empty if device creation failed.

serial_number.description: Serial number of the device. Populated for ZTP onboarding.

parent_id.description: UUID of the parent MNHA device. Only populated for MNHA child devices.

message.description: Failure message. Usually populated when device status is FAILURE.

BulkRemoveDevicesRequest.title: BulkRemoveDevicesRequest

uuids.description: Device UUIDs to remove. For MNHA clusters, only the parent cluster UUID is accepted, child device UUIDs are not allowed.

BulkRemoveDevicesRequest.description: Request to remove devices in batch

BulkRemoveDevicesResponse.title: BulkRemoveDevicesResponse

remove_id.description: Unique identifier for the remove device operation. Use this to query operation status via GetRemoveDeviceStatus.

BulkRemoveDevicesResponse.description: Response containing the remove device operation ID

IngCACertificateUpload.title: IngCACertificateUpload

id.description: CA profile name as reported by the device. Obtain this value from the missing_ca_certificate list in GetRMADeviceStatusV1 and pass it back unchanged so the system can match the uploaded certificate to the correct CA profile.

ignore.description: If true, mark this certificate as ignored instead of uploading it to the device.

IngCACertificateUpload.description: CACertificateUpload describes a single CA certificate to upload or ignore.

IngClusterType.title: IngClusterType
IngClusterType.description:
ClusterType enum defines the device cluster configuration type. Applicable only for BROWN_FIELD.

 - STANDALONE: STANDALONE - Single standalone device
 - L2_CLUSTER: L2_CLUSTER - Clustered device configuration
 - MNHA: MNHA - MNHA cluster device configuration

CreateMnhaClusterRequest.title: CreateMnhaClusterRequest

deployment_type.description: Required. MNHA deployment type. Allowed values: hybrid, routing, switching. Immutable after creation.

liveness_min_interval.description: BFD liveness minimum interval in milliseconds. Valid range: 100–255000. Default: 400 ms (1000 ms for vSRX/SRX4xx devices).

liveness_multiplier.description: BFD liveness multiplier. Valid range: 1–10. Default: 3.

devices.description: Required. Per-device MNHA configurations. Exactly 2 devices required.

north_wan_zones.description: WAN security zones, shared across both devices. Each entry carries the zone name and an optional logical_system_name. Required for switching; optional for hybrid and routing. LAN and WAN zones must not overlap.

south_lan_zones.description: LAN security zones, shared across both devices. Each entry carries the zone name and an optional logical_system_name. Required for switching and hybrid; optional for routing. LAN and WAN zones must not overlap.

prefix_list.description: Named prefix lists, shared across both devices. Not supported in switching mode. A WAN protocol requires at least one WAN prefix list; a LAN protocol requires at least one LAN prefix list.

halink_routing_instance.description: Routing instance in which the HA link (ICL and ICD) interfaces are configured, shared across both devices. Optional.

grid_id.description: Grid identifier shared across all devices. Valid range: 1–15. Omit or set to 0 when not used.

CreateMnhaClusterRequest.description: Request body for creating a new MNHA cluster. deployment_type is immutable after creation.

CreateMnhaClusterResponse.title: CreateMnhaClusterResponse

mnha_cluster_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the newly created MNHA cluster.

CreateMnhaClusterResponse.description: Response from CreateMnhaCluster containing the cluster identifier.

north_wan_interfaces.description: Cluster-level fields shared across both devices.

mode.description: Cluster-wide MNHA configuration mode (basic | advanced). Not part of the core contract.

wan_selected_interface.description:
WAN selected interface (UI construct), the same for both devices. Not part of the core
contract; persisted after the core cluster is created.

DefaultCACertificateConfig.title: DefaultCACertificateConfig

ignore.description: If true, skip generating default CA certificates on the device. If false (default), the system calls EnableDefaultCAProfile on DPM to push the default trusted CA bundle.

DefaultCACertificateConfig.description: Configuration for default CA certificate generation on the device.

name.description: Name or hostname of the device

message.description: Status message. Contains error details on failure.

GetMnhaClusterResponse.title: GetMnhaClusterResponse

mnha_cluster_id.description: Unique identifier (UUID) of the MNHA cluster.

deployment_type.description: MNHA deployment type. Allowed values: hybrid, routing, switching.

liveness_min_interval.description: BFD liveness minimum interval in milliseconds.

north_wan_zones.description: WAN security zones, shared across both devices. Each entry carries the zone name and an optional logical_system_name.

south_lan_zones.description: LAN security zones, shared across both devices. Each entry carries the zone name and an optional logical_system_name.

prefix_list.description: Named prefix lists, shared across both devices.

halink_routing_instance.description: Routing instance in which the HA link (ICL and ICD) interfaces are configured, shared across both devices.

grid_id.description: Grid identifier shared across all devices. 0 indicates not set.

GetMnhaClusterResponse.description: Full MNHA cluster configuration. The response mirrors the Create/Update request structure.

GetMnhaClusterStateResponse.title: GetMnhaClusterStateResponse

status.description: Machine-readable lifecycle status of the MNHA cluster.

display_message.description: Human-readable description of the current cluster status.

current_task.description: Name of the task currently running. Only populated when a deployment or deletion job is in progress.

GetMnhaClusterStateResponse.description: Current lifecycle state of an MNHA cluster with a human-readable description.

IngGetMnhaClusterWrapperResponse.title: IngGetMnhaClusterWrapperResponse

north_wan_interfaces.description: Cluster-level fields shared across both devices.

mode.description: Cluster-wide MNHA configuration mode (basic | advanced). Not part of the core contract.

wan_selected_interface.description: WAN selected interface (UI construct), the same for both devices. Not part of the core contract.

IngGetMnhaClusterWrapperResponse.description:
GetMnhaClusterWrapperResponse mirrors GetMnhaClusterResponse plus the wrapper-only mode and
wan_selected_interface, so the UI can fetch a cluster and round-trip it through the
Create/Update wrapper endpoints. Reads the wrapper-only fields back from the stored config.

GetMnhaVersionFeaturesResponse.title: GetMnhaVersionFeaturesResponse

version_features.description: Map of feature name to minimum OS version specification. Version specs may use slash-separated per-train minimums and + suffix for 'from this version onward'.

min_version.description: Minimum Junos OS version required to create or edit any MNHA cluster.

GetMnhaVersionFeaturesResponse.description: MNHA version feature thresholds from the service configuration.

GetRMADeviceStatusResponse.title: GetRMADeviceStatusResponse

status.description: Current RMA reactivation status: REACTIVATION_COMPLETED (device successfully reactivated), REACTIVATION_PENDING (waiting to start), REACTIVATION_FAILED (reactivation failed), REACTIVATION_IN_PROGRESS (currently reactivating).

failure_reason.description: Detailed failure reason if reactivation failed. Explains what went wrong during the reactivation process. Empty if status is not REACTIVATION_FAILED.

missing_ca_certificate.description: Array of CA certificate names that are missing and required for device reactivation. These certificates must be added to the device model before reactivation can succeed.

missing_certificates.description: Array of device certificate names that are missing and required for reactivation. These certificates must be restored or re-added to the device model.

missing_licenses.description: Array of license keys that are missing and required for device reactivation. These licenses must be re-applied to the device model before reactivation.

GetRMADeviceStatusResponse.description: Detailed RMA reactivation status including current status, failure reasons, and lists of missing resources (certificates, licenses) preventing reactivation.

GetRMAReactivationConfigResponse.title: GetRMAReactivationConfigResponse
GetRMAReactivationConfigResponse.description: Bootstrap reactivation configuration to be applied to the replacement device during RMA reactivation process.

GetReactivationStatusResponse.title: GetReactivationStatusResponse

status.description: Overall operation status: SUCCESS (all steps completed), FAILURE (operation failed), IN_PROGRESS (currently executing), PARTIAL_SUCCESS (some steps succeeded, some failed).

steps.description: Array of execution steps with status for each phase of the operation. Provides granular visibility into operation progress and helps identify failure points.

GetReactivationStatusResponse.description: Detailed status information for an RMA reactivation including step-by-step execution details and overall status.

GetRemoveDeviceStatusResponse.title: GetRemoveDeviceStatusResponse

remove_device_status.description: Per-device removal results with status for each device

GetRemoveDeviceStatusResponse.description: Response containing remove device operation status and results

ImportMnhaConfigResponse.title: ImportMnhaConfigResponse

job_id.description: Identifier of the import job. Use GetMnhaClusterState to poll progress.

ImportMnhaConfigResponse.description: Response from ImportMnhaConfig containing the import job identifier.

IngLicenseUpload.title: IngLicenseUpload

ignore.description: If true, mark this license as ignored instead of uploading it to the device.

IngLicenseUpload.description: LicenseUpload describes a single license to upload or ignore.

IngLocalCertificateUpload.title: IngLocalCertificateUpload

id.description: Local certificate name as reported by the device. Obtain this value from the missing_certificates list in GetRMADeviceStatusV1 and pass it back unchanged so the system can match the uploaded certificate and key to the correct identity on the device.

passphrase.description: Optional passphrase protecting the private key.

ignore.description: If true, mark this certificate as ignored instead of uploading it to the device.

IngLocalCertificateUpload.description: LocalCertificateUpload describes a single local certificate (+key) to upload or ignore.

MnhaBGPConfig.title: MnhaBGPConfig

bgp_type.description: BGP session type. Required. Allowed values: internal, external.

local_address.description: Required. Local BGP address. Must be a plain IP (no prefix) already configured on the interface.

local_as.description: Required. Local autonomous system number. Accepts a plain number (1-4294967294) or asdot notation high.low (e.g. 65535.65534).

peer_as.description: Peer autonomous system number. Required for external BGP; must not be set for internal BGP. Accepts a plain number (1-4294967294) or asdot notation high.low (e.g. 65535.65534).

neighbors.description: Required. List of BGP neighbor IP addresses. At least one entry required.

MnhaBGPConfig.description: BGP protocol configuration for a dynamic routing interface.

MnhaDeviceCliPreview.title: MnhaDeviceCliPreview

cli_diff.description: CLI commands representing the configuration diff

error_message.description: Error message if preview generation failed for this device

MnhaDeviceCliPreview.description: CLI diff preview for a single device in an MNHA cluster

MnhaDeviceConfig.title: MnhaDeviceConfig

device_uuid.description: UUID of the device this MNHA configuration belongs to.

services_redundancy_groups.description: List of services redundancy group configurations.

static_routes.description: Static route entries. routing_instance (if set) must be a virtual-router instance on the device.

protocols.description: Dynamic routing protocol entries for this device. Not supported in switching mode. Each entry specifies a protocol (bgp, ospf, ospf3) and the interface it is configured on. The interface must be a configured WAN, LAN, ICL, or ICD interface on the device. An interface may carry several BGP groups (one entry each) as long as their neighbor IP addresses differ; the same neighbor IP may only be reused on an interface in a different routing instance. bgp cannot be combined with ospf or ospf3 on the same interface.

MnhaDeviceConfig.description: MNHA configuration for a single device node within the cluster.

MnhaIKESettings.title: MnhaIKESettings

dh_group.description: Diffie-Hellman group. Allowed values: group14, group15, group16, group19, group20, group21, group24. Defaults to group19 if not provided.

authentication_algorithm.description: Authentication algorithm for IKE. Allowed values: sha-256, sha-384, sha-512. Default: sha-256. Must not be set when using a GCM encryption algorithm (AEAD — authentication is built in).

encryption_algorithm.description: Encryption algorithm for IKE. Allowed values: aes-128-cbc, aes-128-gcm, aes-192-cbc, aes-192-gcm, aes-256-cbc, aes-256-gcm. Default: aes-256-gcm.

lifetime_seconds.description: IKE SA lifetime in seconds. Valid range: 180–86400. Omit to use the device default.

MnhaIKESettings.description: IKE settings for a VPN profile.

MnhaIPSecSettings.title: MnhaIPSecSettings

encryption_algorithm.description: Encryption algorithm for IPsec. Allowed values: aes-256-gcm. Default: aes-256-gcm.

lifetime_seconds.description: IPsec SA lifetime in seconds. Valid range: 180–86400. Omit to use the device default.

MnhaIPSecSettings.description: IPsec settings for a VPN profile.

MnhaIcdConfig.title: MnhaIcdConfig

loopback_underlay_interfaces.description: Logical underlay interface names associated with the ICD link when the interface is a loopback. Required (at least one) when interface.name starts with lo0; must be empty otherwise.

MnhaIcdConfig.description: ICD (inter-chassis datapath link) configuration. interface.name and interface.ip are required.

MnhaIclConfig.title: MnhaIclConfig

loopback_underlay_interfaces.description: Logical underlay interface names associated with the ICL link when the interface is a loopback. Required (at least one) when interface.name starts with lo0; must be empty otherwise.

MnhaIclConfig.description: ICL (inter-chassis link) configuration. interface.name and interface.ip are required.

MnhaInterconnectSettings.title: MnhaInterconnectSettings

network.description: Interconnect network/subnet in CIDR notation, shared across both devices (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24).

ospf_area.description: OSPF area for the interconnect, shared across both devices. Accepts a plain integer (e.g. 0), a dotted-decimal IP (e.g. 0.0.0.0), or a hostname string.

MnhaInterconnectSettings.description: Cluster-shared logical-tunnel (lt) interconnect settings: the network (CIDR) and OSPF area.

MnhaInterface.title: MnhaInterface

name.description: Logical interface name (e.g. ae0, xe-0/0/0). Required.

ip.description: IPv4 or IPv6 interface address in CIDR notation, including the prefix length (e.g. 192.168.0.1/30 or 2001:db8::1/64). Required. A plain IP without a prefix length is not accepted.

MnhaInterface.description: Interface with a logical name and IP address in CIDR notation.

MnhaOSPFConfig.title: MnhaOSPFConfig

area.description: OSPF area identifier in IP address format (e.g. 0.0.0.0).

MnhaOSPFConfig.description: OSPF/OSPF3 protocol configuration for a dynamic routing interface.

MnhaPreSharedKey.title: MnhaPreSharedKey

type.description: How the pre-shared key is provisioned. Allowed values: autogen, manual. Defaults to autogen if not provided.

value.description: The pre-shared key value. Required when type is manual.

MnhaPreSharedKey.description: Pre-shared key configuration for VPN authentication.

MnhaPrefixList.title: MnhaPrefixList

type.description: Direction of this prefix list. Must be "LAN", "WAN", "ICL" or "ICD".

prefixes.description: List of IP prefixes in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/8 or 2001:db8::/32). A prefix length is required; a plain address is rejected.

logical_system_name.description: Name of the logical system (lsys) or tenant system (tsys) this prefix list is configured in on the device. Empty means the root system.

MnhaPrefixList.description: A named prefix list with one or more IP address prefixes.

MnhaProtocol.title: MnhaProtocol

protocol.description: Dynamic routing protocol type. Allowed values: bgp, ospf, ospf3.

interface.description: Logical interface name on which this dynamic routing protocol is configured. The API derives the system context (root/lsys/tsys) from this interface.

bfd_liveliness.description: Enables BFD liveness detection for this protocol entry. When true, the deploy pushes bfd-liveness-detection minimum-interval and multiplier on the BGP group (protocol bgp) or on the OSPF/OSPF3 area interface (protocol ospf/ospf3), using the cluster-wide liveness timers. Defaults to false.

MnhaProtocol.description: Dynamic routing protocol configuration for an interface. protocol must be 'bgp' or 'ospf'. routing_instance is required for both. zone is required when protocol is 'bgp'.

MnhaSRG0Config.title: MnhaSRG0Config

signal_route_ip.description: Signal route IP address for SRG 0.

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the SRG 0 signal route.

threshold.description: Threshold for SRG 0. Valid range: 1–1000. Only applicable when monitorobject entries are present.

monitorobject.description: Advanced monitoring objects (up to 10). Each requires a threshold and at least one of: interfaces, bfd_liveliness, ip. Mutually exclusive with monitor.

prefix_list.description: Context-aware SRG 0 prefix-list references (name + logical_system_name). Used to generate SRG 0 policy-statements and disambiguate same-named prefix lists across root/lsys/tsys.

ospf_interfaces.description: Logical WAN/LAN interfaces (with a unit suffix, e.g. ge-0/0/2.0) bound to SRG 0 for OSPF, rendered as 'services-redundancy-group 0 interface <name> ospf'. Each interface must belong to a configured WAN or LAN zone on this device and may be bound to only one SRG. Requires Junos 25.4R2 / 25.4X300-D30 / 26.2R2 / 26.4R1+.

bgp_neighbors.description: BGP neighbours associated with SRG 0, each an interface + neighbour-address pair. SRG 0's policy statements are exported only to these neighbours, and only to the ones whose interface is on the side the statement advertises out of. An empty list keeps the legacy behaviour of exporting to every neighbour of the matching interfaces.

MnhaSRG0Config.description: Per-device configuration for the default services redundancy group (SRG 0). Applicable for routing deployment mode only.

MnhaSRGActivenessProbe.title: MnhaSRGActivenessProbe

source_ip.description: Source IP address for the activeness probe.

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address for the activeness probe.

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the activeness probe.

MnhaSRGActivenessProbe.description: Activeness probe (source IP, destination IP, routing instance). Required for routing mode; not applicable for switching or hybrid.

MnhaSRGBgpNeighbor.title: MnhaSRGBgpNeighbor

interface.description: Logical interface (with a unit suffix, e.g. ge-0/0/1.0) whose BGP group carries this neighbour. Must match the interface of a configured BGP protocol entry on this device.

neighbor.description: BGP neighbour address. Must be one of the neighbours configured on the referenced interface's BGP protocol entry.

MnhaSRGBgpNeighbor.description: A BGP neighbour associated with an SRG, identified by the interface its BGP group is configured under and the neighbour address.

MnhaSRGConfig.title: MnhaSRGConfig

srg_no.description: SRG group number. Valid range: 1–20 (routing mode also allows 0 for the default SRG).

is_primary.description: True if this device is the primary (active) node for this SRG.

threshold.description: Threshold for this SRG. Valid range: 1–1000. Only applicable when monitorobject entries are present.

prefix_list.description: Context-aware SRG prefix-list references (name + logical_system_name). Use this to disambiguate same-named prefix lists across root/lsys/tsys. Not supported in switching mode.

virtual_ip.description: Virtual IP entries for this SRG. Not supported in routing mode. Each entry's interface must be a LAN or WAN interface (hybrid and switching). Per SRG: hybrid requires at least one entry on a LAN interface (WAN entries are also allowed); switching requires at least one entry on a LAN interface AND at least one on a WAN interface. In switching and hybrid modes, IPs may be omitted for DHCP interfaces on qualifying Junos versions (25.4X300-D10 / 26.4R1+). IMPORTANT: the FIRST entry (index 0) must always reference an interface with a local IP address — it is used for liveness/activeness-probe calculation — on every Junos version; DHCP and address-less interfaces are only allowed on entries after the first. From Junos 25.4X300-D30 / 26.4R1+ (Interface NAT with VIP, nat_vip), an entry after the first may reference an interface with no local IP address at all (traffic is NAT'd through the virtual IP).

monitorobject.description: Advanced monitoring objects (up to 10). Each requires a threshold and at least one of: interfaces, bfd_liveliness, ip. Mutually exclusive with monitor.

dhcp_server.description: Enable the DHCP server on this services redundancy group.

ospf_interfaces.description: Logical WAN/LAN interfaces (with a unit suffix, e.g. ge-0/0/2.0) bound to this SRG for OSPF, rendered as 'services-redundancy-group <N> interface <name> ospf'. Each interface must belong to a configured WAN or LAN zone on this device and may be bound to only one SRG. Not supported in switching mode. Requires Junos 25.4R2 / 25.4X300-D30 / 26.2R2 / 26.4R1+.

bgp_neighbors.description: BGP neighbours associated with this SRG, each an interface + neighbour-address pair. This SRG's policy statements are exported only to these neighbours, and only to the ones whose interface is on the side the statement advertises out of (a WAN statement exports to WAN neighbours only). An empty list keeps the legacy behaviour of exporting to every neighbour of the matching interfaces. Not supported in switching mode.

MnhaSRGConfig.description: Per-device configuration for a single services redundancy group.

MnhaSRGMonitor.title: MnhaSRGMonitor
MnhaSRGMonitor.description: Monitoring configuration for an SRG with interface, BFD liveliness, and IP monitoring.

MnhaSRGMonitorBFDLiveliness.title: MnhaSRGMonitorBFDLiveliness

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the BFD session. Must be a virtual-router instance if set.

session_type.description: BFD session type. Required. Allowed values: multihop, singlehop.

interface_name.description: Physical interface name (no unit suffix). Required for singlehop; must not be set for multihop.

MnhaSRGMonitorBFDLiveliness.description: BFD liveliness monitoring entry. destination_ip and session_type are required.

MnhaSRGMonitorIP.title: MnhaSRGMonitorIP

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address to monitor. Required.

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the IP monitoring probe. Must be a virtual-router instance if set.

MnhaSRGMonitorIP.description: IP monitoring entry. destination_ip is required.

MnhaSRGMonitoringBFDDest.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringBFDDest

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the BFD session. Must be a virtual-router instance if set.

session_type.description: BFD session type. Required. Allowed values: multihop, singlehop.

interface_name.description: Physical interface name (no unit suffix). Required for singlehop; must not be set for multihop.

weight.description: Weight assigned to this BFD destination. Valid range: 1–1000.

MnhaSRGMonitoringBFDDest.description: A single BFD liveliness destination entry.

MnhaSRGMonitoringBFDLiveliness.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringBFDLiveliness

threshold.description: Threshold value for BFD liveliness monitoring.

destinations.description: List of BFD liveliness destination entries.

MnhaSRGMonitoringBFDLiveliness.description: BFD liveliness monitoring with a threshold and list of BFD destinations.

MnhaSRGMonitoringIP.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringIP

destinations.description: List of IP monitoring destination entries.

MnhaSRGMonitoringIP.description: IP monitoring with a threshold and list of IP destinations.

MnhaSRGMonitoringIPDest.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringIPDest

destination_ip.description: Destination IP address to monitor. Required.

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the IP monitoring probe. Must be a virtual-router instance if set.

weight.description: Weight assigned to this destination. Valid range: 1–1000.

MnhaSRGMonitoringIPDest.description: A single IP monitoring destination entry.

MnhaSRGMonitoringInterfaceItem.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringInterfaceItem

weight.description: Weight assigned to this interface for monitoring.

MnhaSRGMonitoringInterfaceItem.description: A single monitored interface with its weight.

MnhaSRGMonitoringInterfaces.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringInterfaces

interfaces.description: List of monitored interfaces with their weights.

MnhaSRGMonitoringInterfaces.description: Interface monitoring with a threshold and list of monitored interfaces.

MnhaSRGMonitoringObject.title: MnhaSRGMonitoringObject

threshold.description: Threshold value for this monitoring object.

MnhaSRGMonitoringObject.description: Monitoring object with optional name, threshold, and monitoring categories (interfaces, BFD liveliness, IP).

MnhaSRGPrefixListRef.title: MnhaSRGPrefixListRef

names.description: Prefix-list names matching top-level prefix_list entries in the same system context.

logical_system_name.description: Name of the logical system (lsys) or tenant system (tsys) all listed names belong to. Empty means the root system.

MnhaSRGPrefixListRef.description: One or more top-level prefix_list names that share the same system context (root/lsys/tsys). Group all names for a given system into a single entry.

MnhaSRGSignalRoute.title: MnhaSRGSignalRoute

routing_instance.description: Routing instance for the active and backup signal routes.

MnhaSRGSignalRoute.description: Signal route (active + backup IPs). Required for routing and hybrid modes; not applicable for switching.

MnhaSRGVirtualIP.title: MnhaSRGVirtualIP

interface.description: Interface name on which the virtual IP is configured. The interface referenced by the first entry (index 0) in the parent virtual_ip list must always have a local IP address, used for liveness/activeness-probe calculation — the DHCP / nat_vip no-local-IP exceptions apply only to later entries.

ip.description: List of virtual IP addresses in CIDR notation. From SRX 26.2R1: up to 2 entries (one IPv4 + one IPv6). From SRX 26.4R1: multiple IPv4 and IPv6 addresses allowed in the same entry.

use_virtual_mac.description: When true, a virtual MAC address is used alongside the virtual IP.

MnhaSRGVirtualIP.description: Virtual IP entry for an SRG: interface name, device IP, virtual IP in CIDR notation, and optional virtual MAC behaviour.

MnhaStaticRoute.title: MnhaStaticRoute

route.description: Destination route in CIDR notation (IPv4 or IPv6, e.g. 10.0.0.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32). Required.

routing_instance.description: Routing instance in which this static route is installed. Optional.

next_hop.description: List of next-hop IP addresses or interface names for this static route.

logical_system_name.description: Name of the logical system (lsys) or tenant system (tsys) this static route is configured in on the device. Empty means the root system.

MnhaStaticRoute.description: Static route entry. route must be in CIDR notation (e.g. 10.0.0.0/24 or 2001:db8::/32).

IngSaveMnhaDraftRequest.title: IngSaveMnhaDraftRequest
IngSaveMnhaDraftRequest.description:
SaveMnhaDraftRequest is the request body for saving MNHA cluster configuration as a draft.
It has the same structure as CreateMnhaClusterRequest. If the devices are not yet part of
an MNHA cluster, the cluster is modelled (parent device, group, and per-device mnhaconfig
records are created). If they are already a cluster, that step is skipped. In both cases the
mnhastatus record is upserted with DRAFT status. No input validation is performed.

CFNotificationOptionsCFNotificationType.title: CFNotificationOptionsCFNotificationType
CFNotificationOptionsCFNotificationType.description:
CFNotificationType specifies the method used to deliver virus detection notifications.

 - PROTOCOL: Notification is sent via protocol-level mechanism.
 - MESSAGE: Notification is sent as a message.
 - NONE: No notification is sent.

CFProfileOptionsCFAction.title: CFProfileOptionsCFAction
CFProfileOptionsCFAction.description:
Action specifies the enforcement action to be taken when a policy rule is triggered.

 - NO_ACTION: No action, policy is logged only
 - BLOCK: Block the traffic and terminate the connection
 - CLOSE_CLIENT_AND_SERVER: Close both client and server connections
 - CLOSE_CLIENT: Close the client connection only
 - CLOSE_SERVER: Close the server connection only

CFProfileOptionsCFDirection.title: CFProfileOptionsCFDirection
CFProfileOptionsCFDirection.description:
Direction specifies the traffic flow direction for policy enforcement.

 - DOWNLOAD: Incoming/download traffic direction
 - UPLOAD: Outgoing/upload traffic direction
 - ANY: Both incoming and outgoing traffic directions

Cleanup mode for policy removal operations.

 - STRICT: Undeploy from all devices first. Only remove assignments and policy if all undeploys succeed. If any device undeploy fails, entire cleanup fails (default)
 - IGNORE_UNDEPLOY_FAILURES: Attempt undeploy from all devices. Remove assignments and policy regardless of undeploy success/failure.

apiNatAddressPooling.title: apiNatAddressPooling
apiNatAddressPooling.description:
NatAddressPooling controls address pooling behaviour for a NAT pool.

 - NONE: NONE is the default; no address pooling.
 - PAIRED: PAIRED pairs source addresses with pool addresses.
 - NON_PAIRED: NON_PAIRED does not pair source with pool addresses.

apiNatApplicationMatchType.title: apiNatApplicationMatchType
apiNatApplicationMatchType.description:
Application match type for NAT rules.

 - NAT_APP_MATCH_NONE: No application match — apply to all traffic.
 - NAT_APP_MATCH_SERVICE: Match by application service objects.
 - NAT_APP_MATCH_PROTOCOLS: Match by protocol and port.

apiNatOverFlowPoolType.title: apiNatOverFlowPoolType
apiNatOverFlowPoolType.description:
NatOverFlowPoolType identifies the overflow pool type for a NAT pool.

 - OFP_NONE: OFP_NONE is the default; no overflow pool is used.
 - INTERFACE: INTERFACE indicates the interface address is used as the overflow pool.
 - POOL: POOL indicates a separate NAT pool is used as the overflow pool.

apiNatTranslationType.title: apiNatTranslationType
apiNatTranslationType.description:
Translation method used for NAT address conversion.

 - NAT_TRANSLATION_NO_TRANSLATION: No translation
 - NAT_TRANSLATION_PREFIX: Prefix-based translation (Also called ADDRES translation)
 - NAT_TRANSLATION_POOL: Pool-based translation - Applicable only for SOURCE and DESTINATION NAT rules.
 - NAT_TRANSLATION_INTERFACE: Interface-based translation - Applicable only for SOURCE NAT rules.
 - NAT_TRANSLATION_NPTV6: NPTv6 (Network Prefix Translation for IPv6). Applicable only for STATIC NAT rules.
 - NAT_TRANSLATION_INET: INET translation (CORRESPONDING_IPV4). Applicable only for STATIC NAT rules.
